concepts.description: A fundamental proof in number theory demonstrating that the square root of two cannot be expressed as a simple fraction, often proven by contradiction.
concepts.name: Irrationality of the Square Root of Two

concepts.description: Euclid's theorem stating that there are infinitely many prime numbers, a classic proof often using contradiction or construction.
concepts.name: Infinitude of Primes

concepts.description: A basic proof in number theory demonstrating that the result of adding any two odd integers will always be an even integer.
concepts.name: Sum of Two Odd Integers
